description: Wait for the page to navigate to a new URL. It waits for the next navigation event, so a navigation that already finished is not seen and the call waits until timeout_ms. Pages that update without changing URL (AJAX/SPA) fire no navigation event. Optional timeout_ms (default 30000ms).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait in milliseconds (default 30000, max 60000)

name: browser_wait_for_navigation
